betterquesting:10.desc:8:
The heart of your AE2 network. Every network needs at least one ME Controller, and it does three things: defines the network boundary, stores 8000 AE of power buffer, and provides channels to connected devices.

Controllers form a multiblock up to 7x7x7. Each face on the multiblock provides 32 channels via dense cable, so a 3x3x3 cube gives you 6 usable faces with 32 channels each. Bigger cube means more channels per face.

The controller also has 3.0 AE/t idle power draw, so make sure your power setup can handle it.

§ePS:§f You can only have ONE controller multiblock per network. Two controllers that try to form separate networks on the same cables will conflict.
